---
name: Security or privacy concern
about: Do not file vulnerabilities here
labels: security
---

**Do not describe vulnerabilities, exposed data or credentials in an issue.**

Report them privately through the repository's Security tab ("Report a vulnerability") or the
security contact defined by the organization's incident policy. Rotate any exposed credential
immediately.

Use this template only for non-sensitive hardening work (e.g. "add rate limiting to endpoint X").
